slides.texte_overlay:
little signs you're more
intelligent than you think

you double check yourself

you question your own first answer before you trust it. people who know a lot tend to know exactly how much they don't, so a little self doubt is a very good sign.

routine bores you quickly

repetition and small talk drain your energy fast. a mind that needs fresh ideas to stay awake is usually a mind that is always searching for something to understand.

you can't stop wondering

you wonder why the sky is blue or how old the moon is, and you love finding out the answers. that constant wondering is the habit behind almost every brilliant mind.
slides.texte_sophia:
you can't stop wondering

i can never stop wondering. i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, why cats purr or how stars die, and feeding that curiosity keeps my mind sharp and happy.

slides.texte_overlay:
you talk things through

you solve problems by thinking out loud, quietly or not. saying your thoughts in words slows them down and organises them, which is exactly why it leads to better answers.

you notice what others miss

you spot small details nobody else sees: a change in someone's tone, a crooked picture, a pattern in numbers. close attention is one of the quietest signs of intelligence.
